name: Lian Yu Zhizuoren
source:
Who will be your soul mate? Mr Love: Queen's Choice is a romance simulation game that gives you the opportunity to text, chat and even call the main characters while developing your own career as a media producer. In a world filled with superpowers, fantasy, and surprise, you will experience a girl’s whole life and get deeply involved with 4 male characters, feeling their romance, love, mystery and conflict in a deep story spanning dozens of episodes.

[From [url=https://mr-love-queens-choice.fandom.com/wiki/Love_And_Producer_Wiki]Mr Love: Queen's Choice wiki on Fandom[/url]]
translation:
你的灵魂伴侣会是谁？《恋与制作人》是一款恋爱模拟游戏，你可以在发展媒体制作人事业的同时，给主要角色发短信、聊天，甚至打电话。在充满超能力、幻想与惊喜的世界中，你将体验一个女孩的完整人生，深入参与4名男性角色的故事，感受他们的浪漫、爱情、谜团与冲突。

[来源：[url=https://mr-love-queens-choice.fandom.com/wiki/Love_And_Producer_Wiki]Fandom上的《恋与制作人》Wiki[/url]]
